# Edward Omondi

> Full-Stack Software Engineer and Solutions Architect based in Nairobi, Kenya, with 5+ years of experience across the Java/Spring, Vue/Nuxt, and Angular ecosystems. Co-founder and architect of two live SaaS platforms. Background in Mechatronics Engineering bridging hardware and software (IoT, Raspberry Pi, RFID).

Contact: ewomondi@gmail.com · https://github.com/EdwardOmondi · https://linkedin.com/in/edwardomondi-6644b7a8/

## Core Skills

- Backend: Java, Spring Boot, Spring MVC, Jakarta EE, FastAPI
- Frontend: Vue.js, Nuxt, Angular
- Mobile: Flutter, Kotlin (Jetpack Compose), Swift (SwiftUI)
- Databases: PostgreSQL, MySQL, Firebase
- Security: OAuth 2.0, Keycloak, Certified Ethical Hacker (CEH)
- Messaging / Event-Driven Architecture: Apache Artemis, JMS
- DevOps / Cloud: Linux, AWS, DigitalOcean, Docker, Kubernetes, Jenkins, CI/CD
- IoT / Embedded: Raspberry Pi, microcontrollers, RFID
